 Inspiration 

 Building interactive web applications that empower users with real-time agent tools and browser automation highlighted the need for a seamless interface bridging client-side interaction with robust execution layers. 

 What it does 

 HeartSync AI provides an intelligent web application interface built with WebMCP, enabling smooth real-time interactions, automated workflows, and seamless agent coordination directly within the browser environment. 

 How we built it 

 Architected using modern web technologies and deployed via Netlify, integrating responsive front-end structures and modular scripts designed for high-performance cross-platform compatibility. 

 Challenges we ran into 

 Ensuring zero-latency client interactions and smooth cross-browser execution while maintaining a clean, accessible layout for real-time AI and agent-driven workflows. 

 Accomplishments that we're proud of 

 Successfully deploying a fully functional, highly responsive WebMCP-powered application live on Netlify under clean production standards.
